purpose: Teach: 本島/丹波/三条/名護/代々木/松戸/加賀/小田原

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「沖縄本島、つまり本島の海はきれい」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho — your dad was saying the sea around Okinawa's main island is really beautiful.
lines.style: Soft, conversational opening. Warm recollection in her tone, sharing something she found worth mentioning. Gentle pace, like she's bringing him into her own memory of the conversation.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと京都丹波の黒豆ご飯食べたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis — I went with Dad and we had kurogane beans and rice in Kyoto's Tamba region.
lines.style: Bright, eager delivery. Quick pace on the opening — reaching for her attention. Pride in the shared experience with his father. Small-boy genuine, no performance.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「新潟県三条の包丁は名品」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho — your dad was telling me that the knives from Sanjo in Niigata are really exceptional.
lines.style: Thoughtful, almost musing tone. Settling back into a memory. Slower pace than before. The kind of detail she finds interesting enough to pass along — gentle respect in her delivery.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと沖縄県名護市のパイナップル園行ったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis — I got to visit a pineapple farm in Nago with Dad.
lines.style: Excited, lighter than before. Quick tempo. The words tumble out — he's sharing something he's been holding onto. Genuine child delight, not performed brightness.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが代々木公園で散歩する事を楽しんでらっしゃるわ
lines.en: Sho — your dad really enjoys taking walks in Yoyogi Park.
lines.style: Calm, observational tone. Softly present. Like she's noticed this about his father and is offering it as a small gift of understanding. Unhurried, genuine.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと千葉県松戸市の小金牧場跡見たよ
lines.en: Mei-sis — Dad took me to see the old Koganemaki ranch site in Matsudo, Chiba.
lines.style: Warm, reaching outward — matching her tone now but still boyish. Direct and sincere. Small pause before the place names, like he's making sure he gets them right to show he was paying attention.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「石川県加賀温泉のお湯は格別」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho — your dad was saying the hot spring water at Kaga in Ishikawa is truly something special.
lines.style: Reflective, almost wistful. Warm admiration for his father's appreciation. Slightly slower pace. The word 'special' carries weight — she's honoring what his father values.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと神奈川県小田原城を観光したよ
lines.en: Mei-sis — I went sightseeing at Odawara Castle with Dad.
lines.style: Bright, satisfied close. Warm and direct. A slight lift at the end — he's offering her something that makes him happy, and he's hoping she'll be happy too. Genuine boy-joy.
